purpose: Teach: ソヴィエト/マオリ/秦/劉/宋/萬/鵐/カキ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ソヴィエト連邦時代の経済史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on Soviet-era economic history, correct?
lines.style: Steady, curious opener. Warm but professional—a teacher checking in, not testing. Light emphasis on the topic to signal she's engaged with his work. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ニュージーランドのマオリ文化研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote mine on Maori cultural studies in New Zealand.
lines.style: Careful, slightly self-conscious. Answering precisely because he wants to be understood. Soft attack on the opening word. No rush—letting each phrase land.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中国古代の秦王朝の制度研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you explored institutional structures of China's ancient Qin dynasty in your work, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently probing—as if she's piecing together something she's half-remembered about his interests. Calm, interested tone. Slight lift of curiosity at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、漢の劉邦、つまり劉氏王朝の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the Han dynasty—Liu Bang's dynasty, the Liu lineage specifically.
lines.style: Precise and careful. Small pause before clarifying, as if wanting to be sure he's explaining it right. Quiet determination underneath. No performance, just accuracy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、宋朝の文芸復興の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you also looked into the cultural flourishing of the Song dynasty for your paper?
lines.style: Warm reflection—almost thinking aloud. She's clearly noticed a pattern in his interests. Gentle tone, not pressing. Slight trailing curiosity, inviting him to confirm or clarify.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、旧字「萬」、つまり万の使われ方の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I researched the old character for 'ten thousand'—how the kanji 萬 was used historically.
lines.style: Quiet correction, but not defensive. He's clarifying the distinction because it matters to him. Steady pace. Slight emphasis on the specific detail—this is what actually interested him.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、希少鳥類の鵐、つまり鵐属の分類研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper covered the classification of rare bunting birds—the genus itself, I believe?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective question. Her tone suggests she's slightly uncertain here, inviting confirmation. Warm but observant. The slight hesitation signals genuine curiosity, not a gotcha.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、養殖業の牡蠣、つまりカキの生態研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Right—I studied the ecology of farmed oysters, their breeding and habitat patterns.
lines.style: Soft but clear. Finishing with quiet completion, as if he's satisfied with the correction. No frustration, just the gentle clarity of someone who knows what he actually worked on. Grounded closer.
